questions.question: The largest 5 - digit number exactly divisible by 88 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be divisible by 88, it must be exactly divisible by its co-prime factors, 8 and 11.

Check the given options for divisibility by 8 (last 3 digits) and 11 (difference of alternating sums).

Checking Option 4 (99968): 968 ÷ 8 = 121, so it is divisible by 8.

For 11: Sum of odd places = (9 + 9 + 8) = 26; Sum of even places = (9 + 6) = 15.

Difference = 26 − 15 = 11, which is divisible by 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 99968.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

We need to find the largest 5-digit number exactly divisible by 88.

**Method Used:**

Divide the largest 5-digit number by 88 and subtract the remainder from it to get a completely divisible number.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The largest 5-digit number is 99999.

⇒ Let us divide 99999 by 88 to find the remainder.

⇒ 99999 = 88 × 1136 + 31

⇒ The remainder when 99999 is divided by 88 is 31.

⇒ To make it exactly divisible by 88, we subtract this remainder from the largest 5-digit number.

⇒ Required number = 99999 − 31

⇒ Required number = 99968

**∴ The correct answer is 99968.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is completely divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd positions and the sum of digits at even positions is 0 or a multiple of 11.

Finding the Largest n-digit Divisible Number

Divide the highest n-digit number (e.g., 99999) by the given divisor. The required answer is the highest n-digit number minus the obtained remainder.
</p

questions.question: If a + (1)/(a) = 7, then a⁵ + (1)/(a⁵) is equal to:
Find the value of cos 47° sec 133° + sin 44° cosec 136°.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert obtuse angles to supplementary forms: 133° = 180° − 47° and 136° = 180° − 44°.

Using 2ⁿd quadrant rules: sec(180° − θ) = −sec θ and cosec(180° − θ) = cosec θ.

Expression = cos 47° × (−sec 47°) + sin 44° × cosec 44°.

Since cos θ × sec θ = 1 and sin θ × cosec θ = 1:

Result = −1 + 1 = 0.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = cos 47° sec 133° + sin 44° cosec 136°

**Formula Used:**

sec(180° − θ) = −sec θ

cosec(180° − θ) = cosec θ

cos θ × sec θ = 1

sin θ × cosec θ = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ Split the obtuse angles into (180° − θ) form to simplify.

⇒ sec 133° = sec(180° − 47°) = −sec 47°

⇒ cosec 136° = cosec(180° − 44°) = cosec 44°

⇒ Substitute these simplified values back into the given expression.

⇒ Expression = cos 47° × (−sec 47°) + sin 44° × cosec 44°

⇒ Expression = −(cos 47° × sec 47°) + (sin 44° × cosec 44°)

⇒ Since a trigonometric function multiplied by its reciprocal is exactly 1:

⇒ Expression = −1 + 1 = 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

ASTC Rule

In the 2ⁿd quadrant (90° to 180°), only Sine (sin) and Cosecant (cosec) are positive. Cosine (cos), Secant (sec), Tangent (tan), and Cotangent (cot) are negative.

Reciprocal Identities

sin θ × cosec θ = 1 | cos θ × sec θ = 1 | tan θ × cot θ = 1.

Supplementary Angles

Angles that add up to 180° are supplementary. sin(180° − θ) = sin θ, while cos(180° − θ) = −cos θ.

questions.question: A, B and C run simultaneously, starting from a point, around a circular track of length 1200 m, at respective speeds of 2 m/s, 4 m/s and 6 m/s. A and B run in the same direction, while C runs in the opposite direction to the other two. After how much time will they meet for the first time?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total track length = 1200 m

Speed of A = 2 m/s ; speed of B = 4 m/s

Speed of C = 6 m/s

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Relative speed of A and B = (4 - 2) = 2 m/s

Relative speed of B and C = (6 + 4) = 10 m/s

Relative speed of A and C = (6 + 2) = 8 m/s

Time taken by A and B = 1200/2 = 600 sec

Time taken by B and C = 1200/10 = 120 sec

Time taken by A and C = 1200/8 = 150 sec

A, B and C will meet at = L.C.M {600,120, 150} = 600 sec = 600/60 = 10 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 10 minutes.**

questions.question: A sum of money invested at a certain rate of simple interest per annum amounts to Rs. 14,522 in seven years and to Rs. 18,906 in eleven years. Find the sum invested (in Rs.).
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Amount produce in 7 years = Rs.14522

Amount produce in 11 years = Rs.18906

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Amount produce in 7 years = Rs.14522

Amount produce in 11 years = Rs.18906

S.I produced in (11 - 7) = 4 years = (18906 - 14522) = Rs.4384

S.I in 1 years = 4384/4 = 1096

Principal = 14522 - (1096 × 7)

⇒ (14522 - 7672) = Rs.6850

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.6850.**

questions.question: A thief is spotted by a constable from 200 m. When the constable starts the chase, the thief also starts running. If the speed of the constable is 8 km/h and thief runs at the speed of 6 km/h, then how far (in m) will the thief be able to run before he is overtaken?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between constable and thief = 200 m

Speed of constable = 8 km/h

Speed of thief = 6 km/h

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ 200 = (8 - 6) × (5/18) × time

⇒ 200 = 2 × (5/18) × time

⇒ Time = (200 × 18)/10

⇒ Time = 360 sec

Distance covered by thief = 6 × (5/18) × 360

⇒ 6 × 100 = 600 m

**∴ The correct answer is 600 m.**

questions.question: An arc of length 23.1 cm subtends an 18° angle at the centre. What is the area of the circle? [Use π = (22)/(7)]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of an arc = 23.1 cm

Angle subtended on center by arc = 18°

**Formula used:**

Length of an arc = (2 × π × R × θ)/360

Area of circle = π × R²

Where, R = radius

**Calculation:**

Length of an arc = (2 × π × R × θ)/360

⇒ 23.1 = (2 × 22 × R × 18)/(360 × 7)

⇒ 23.1 = (22 × R)/(10 × 7)

⇒ R = (2.1 × 70)/2 = 73.5 cm

Area of circle = π × R2

⇒ (22/7) × 73.5 × 73.5

⇒ 22 × 10.5 × 73.5

⇒ 16978.50 cm2

**∴ The correct answer is 16978.50 cm2.**

questions.question: Working 5 hours a day, A can complete a task in 8 days and working 6 hours a day, B can finish the same task in 10 days. Working 8 hours a day, they can jointly complete the task in __________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A working hours = 5 hours/day

A can complete a task = 8 days

B working hours = 6 hours/day

B can finish the same task = 10 days

**Concept used:**

M₁ × D₁ × H₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂

M = person ; D = days ; H = hours 

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

⇒ A × 5 × 8 = B × 6 × 10

⇒ A/B = 3/2

Total work = A × 5 × 8 = 3 × 40 = 120 units

Required time taken = 120/{(3 + 2) × 8}

⇒ 120/40 = 3 days

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

questions.question:
Simplify,

(x⁴ - 2x² + 1)/(x² - 2x + 1)
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

(a² - b²) = (a + b) × (a - b)

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

**Calculation:**

(x⁴ - 2x² + 1)/(x² - 2x + 1)

⇒ {(x²)² + 1 - 2 × (x²) × 1}/(x - 1)²

⇒ (x² - 1)²/(x - 1)²

⇒ {(x + 1)²(x - 1)²}/(x - 1)²

⇒ (x + 1)2 = x2 + 2x + 1

**∴ The correct option is 3.**
